content.content:
1. Necessity: the prerequisites fix what the registry holds, the record's shape, its states and the one-way move between them, and the reading of the registry against the workspaces jj owns - which records are read, what is reported per record, when an absence counts, and that the reading repairs nothing. None of them is a model, so it is unsettled whether a machine holds one reading at once: over which set of records the report ranges, how a record's state and the existence of the workspace it names combine into a per-record determination, and what the reading leaves unchanged. Fail if the model artifact could be dropped without loss.

2. Fidelity, both directions, applied to the model the dependent's content refs, read against each prerequisite as each is recorded at check time:

a. No looser - every fact a prerequisite fixes about the reading is carried by the model, whichever of these it states: that the reading ranges over the registry's records as the record form files them, each record once under its key and landed ones included; that the report is per record and carries what that record says, including the state and the workspace reference it names; that a report the reading builds is a report the model can actually produce - each entry the reconcile filter keeps is inserted into the accumulator the report starts from by a key-inserting write (in Quint, `Map::put` on an absent key) or a map builder, so a non-empty report is reachable, while a write that only assigns at a key the map must already hold (in Quint, `Map::set` on an absent key) raises at the first kept record and reports nothing, so it does not carry the fact that reconcile reports the records the drift determination holds of, the finding naming the write, its operator and its line; that existence is jj's answer and is not inferred from the registry; that the record's state decides whether a missing workspace counts, and the record whose draft has landed is not drift; and that the reading changes nothing - no record added, removed or rewritten, no state moved, no workspace created or removed. A fact the model omits, weakens or leaves unconstrained is a loose divergence: name the fact and the prerequisite that fixes it.

b. No stricter - the model requires, forbids or constrains nothing a prerequisite does not fix: no state, category or outcome beyond the ones the record form names and the determination the reading fixes; no drift where the lifecycle says the absence is not drift; no repair, creation, removal or rewrite of a record or a workspace; no storage or serialization fact (a path, a filename, a JSON encoding, a tracking flag) modelled as part of the record or the report; no listing of nodes, edges or edits; no verb name, argument or output-surface rule; and no ordering, count or presentation rule the prerequisites do not state. Any such element is a strict divergence: name it and the rule it adds.

c. The record form - where a prerequisite carries a machine-checkable artifact that fixes the record's fields, its states and its references, the model's reading is read against that artifact field by field and value by value: a fact the artifact fixes and the model contradicts, omits or weakens; a field the model adds; a state value the artifact does not have; a move the artifact does not admit; and a reference the model recasts or drops are divergences, each named in the direction it falls. That shape is the artifact's, read at check time; it is not restated here.

The criterion names no element of the model or of the dependencies in advance: which record, field or extra rule is at issue is found while reading the artifact against the recorded prerequisites, and appears only in the finding. It tracks no wording of the dependent and survives a rewording of the dependent that leaves what it decides unchanged.
content.rationale:
One model carries both readings this unit claims - the reconcile reading and the drafts listing - and all three edges claim it. The dependent is a Quint module, a tool-checkable artifact, so the two requirement sentences sit on the conformance cell (structured-to-code) and the registry model on the test cell (code-to-code). The check is necessity plus fidelity: the model must enforce exactly the reading the prerequisites fix, neither looser nor stricter. That is the right gate because the artifact's shape is in question, not its running - a well-typed model can still report a landed record as drifted, drop the landed records the registry keeps, infer existence from the registry instead of from jj, or step a repair, and each of those diverges in one direction a one-directional check would miss.

This gate was amended to add the executability of the reconcile report to the no-looser direction. The old criterion read the model's shape and could count one report row per drifted record without asking whether the report can be built: a fold that assigns with `Map::set` at a key the accumulator does not yet hold still reads as one entry per drifted record, yet `Map::set` does not insert, so on the empty accumulator the fold starts from it reports nothing and `reconcile` can never return a non-empty report - it does not carry yozqornv's report. The added fact is the executable side of the same prerequisite fact - each drifted record is actually reported - and it pins no implementation: the reviewer reads the write at the reconcile accumulator against the map the fold starts from, and the finding names the operator and the line. Every other fact and every exclusion of the criterion is unchanged.

It is applied by reading the model against each prerequisite as recorded at check time, so it reads whatever the prerequisites land and pins none of their wording: the two requirement sentences are skeletons in this layer and are read as each lands, and the registry model is read as recorded, and the criterion presupposes no clause their final text must contain. The record's field set, its state values and its one-way move are the registry artifact's, read at check time rather than pre-authored here.

One evaluation covers all three edges because they claim one model from three sides and a single pass over the model answers all three; splitting would read the same artifact three times. Nothing stands as a separate test path: a Quint typecheck of the model is only the precondition that the artifact parses, and the review is the gate - in this form red is the artifact's absence, the prerequisites' reading unenforced until the model exists, and, once it exists, any fact of the criterion it does not carry, including a reconcile report that cannot be built from the accumulator it starts from. A throwaway `quint run` of `reconcile` over a registry holding one drifted record, made in a copy outside the repository and outside this unit's write set, is evidence the reviewer may use for the report's reachability, not a check path this evaluation adds. The code-to-code edge's cell asks for a runnable check; this unit's write set licenses no check path beyond the evaluation node and the model itself, so that edge is read as a field-by-field comparison plus the report's executability under a run, and the cell is flagged for a matrix entry.
